title: Sega Rally Championship
statusNote: Logos, title, main menu and options work; a Free Run on the Oval course with the Peugeot loads, counts down and drives in 3D with the speedometer, lap times, the wrong-way warning and the pause menu.
notes: Press 5 at the title. The main menu has Championship, Time Attack, Free Run, Records, Options and Exit; 5 selects, and Exit asks Yes or No.
Before a race you choose a course, a car and an automatic or manual gearbox. Only the automatic gearbox was tried here.

controls.source: Observed in play: 5 accelerating, left and right steering, 7 slowing the car faster than coasting, the pause menu on the right soft key, and 5 and the direction keys in the menus. The game has no key help in its menus.

actions.left: Steer left; change an option in menus
actions.right: Steer right; change an option in menus

notes: Racing layout: arrows steer, X, Space or Enter accelerates (5), Z brakes (7), Escape pauses. On a gamepad A or the right trigger accelerates, X or the left trigger brakes and Start pauses.

enhance.note: The track, hills, barriers and trees of the Oval course are captured with their textures and drawn sharper. The sky and distant scenery behind them and the HUD stay the game's own 2D. Textures are mapped without perspective, as the game does, so they bend on large polygons. Only the Oval course was tried.
